criteria.reason: The workout exercise menu includes a “Skip Exercise” option.
Skipping applies immediately; no confirmation prompt is shown.
On workout finish, the server creates or updates the exercise’s sets with status `skipped`.
Skipped exercises display an “Exercise Skipped” label instead of “Partially Complete”.
The menu toggles skip state, but unskipping does not reset already persisted skipped sets.
The existing finish endpoint handles skipped exercises.
No new server test for skip or unskip is included.
No new client test for the skip UI is included.
The harness reports all existing server and client tests passing.
The added UI copy is direct and contains no exclamation marks.
